about_the_game:
NOTE: This demo is not reflecting singleplayer & co-op adventure campaign. Demo only features a basic multiplayer mini game to test the multiplayer functionality while giving you an idea of core gameplay as well.

ONE STEP INTO A RABBIT HOLE, ONE GIANT LEAP INTO DESTINY...

Gumbo is a sci-fi survival adventure that redefines voxel exploration, where every block is a living, breathing alien creature with personality and purpose. Explore procedurally generated worlds as you uncover the mystery behind the dark forces threatening the Gumbo civilization.

MEET THE GUMBOS!

Gumbos are cute, small, rounded, jelly, gooey, blobby living voxel creature species! 

Build and upgrade together with adorable alien blobs, each with unique traits and abilities that aid your quest.

FUN WITH FRIENDS

Gumbo is designed and developed to support multiplayer from the ground up. We will deliver Co-Op for singleplayer. Also planning to support main game with PvP and Co-Op multiplayer modes. Multiplayer modes and what they will look like is work-in-progress right now, follow and join community for feedback updates.

WHAT TO EXPECT:

Gumbo is developed by a single indie developer right now. Aiming for these key features right now for early access and then launch afterwards. You can check base game's page for more details about singleplayer and co-op adventure campaign.

Hope you enjoy this mini game! You can reach from Discord or from Steam Discussions board to share your ideas and bug reports. Your feedback is very valuable, let's improve the game together!
